annotations.annotation: The instrument was put in periodic sampling mode while the profiler is stationary. Periodic sampling parameters set to 1 sec sampling every 5 min.

On December 30th, the Axial Shallow Profiler tripped on level wind high current during a downcast at a depth of 40m. Troubleshooting indicated that there was mechanical binding at one side of the level wind mechanism and/or cart, and as a result the SP Float could not be moved deeper. Instrument operation and data recording were not affected by this fault and data continued to flow with the float at 40m.
